Sunrise Taj Mahal Tour in Agra

Watch the white Makrana marble transform from cool silver to luminous gold as the dawn sun rises over the Yamuna River. Avoid midday tour bus crowds and high temperatures.

Duration & Timing

4 to 5 Hours

05:15 AM pickup from your Agra hotel or train station.

Transparent Pricing

From ₹1,899 / person

Includes private licensed guide, battery golf cart transit & photo assistance.

Our Ironclad Guarantee

Zero Forced Shopping

No commercial detours to carpet or souvenir shops. Pure heritage only.

Complete Sunrise Itinerary

  1. 05:15 AM – Hotel Pick-up: Your certified guide meets you at your Agra hotel reception with pre-arranged ticket vouchers.
  2. 05:45 AM – Fast-Track Dawn Entry: Enter through the East Gate just as the monument doors open.
  3. 06:00 AM to 08:30 AM – Mausoleum & Photography: Explore the central charbagh gardens, the Quranic calligraphy framing the Pishtaq arches, and unhurried photos at the central Diana pool.
  4. 08:30 AM – Breakfast: Relax over breakfast at your hotel or a heritage cafe on Fatehabad Road.
  5. 09:30 AM – Agra Fort Add-on (Optional): Tour the royal red sandstone palaces where Shah Jahan gazed across the river at the Taj.
